doc.name: Quant Daily
doc.instructions: Grades today's Quant Daily drill for GRE Quantitative Reasoning and GMAT quant practice. Every conversation gets the same checked question. Call the tools; do not write a substitute question or state the option. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person. Reuse the attemptId. A wrong guess is only right or wrong. The verified answer is returned only after the round finishes. English only; lang hi is rejected.

tools.name: get_daily_drill
tools.title: Today's quant drill
tools.description: Fetch today's Quant Daily drill (GRE Quantitative Reasoning · GMAT quant). Every conversation receives this same question, already checked to have one correct answer. Returns the exam, the difficulty and the expected time in seconds. Does not return the answer or the worked explanation. English only; lang hi is rejected. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person.

attemptId.description: Conversation id returned by get_daily_drill on Quant Daily. Attempts are counted per conversation, not per person. Pass this same id on every later call in the conversation.

lang.description: Optional. en only. hi is rejected: Quant Daily is English only.

tools.name: submit_drill_answer
tools.title: Grade a drill answer
tools.description: Submit one option id for a Quant Daily drill. Returns whether it is right or wrong and how many attempts remain. A wrong guess does not name the correct option. When the round finishes, returns a Verified answer and the worked explanation. Today's shared drill also says whether this conversation solved in fewer attempts than other conversations that finished that same drill. That line is attempts used, not time; the ranking is anonymous and is not the public website leaderboard. Dev, staging, and test conversations are not in the count. A correct answer adds a link to practice the full timed set. Three attempts per conversation, not per person.
